prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated reusable building sprite for tianshu default building-map, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city (Beijing/Datong/Xian regional vocabulary), anonymous original period-inspired design, not a measured heritage reconstruction. Input image is STYLE reference only: match its restrained realistic material detail, fine grey clay roof tiles, weathered masonry and natural matte wood, and same detail density. Change architecture to Ming north as specified. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric ground projection, camera yaw45 elevation30, east axis down-right slope +0.5 and north up-right slope -0.5; parallel ground edges, vertical posts, no perspective convergence. South entrance on screen lower-left edge. Complete building on thin rectangular ground-contact footprint with readable left, front, right corners, footprint axis ratio as specified, no thick pedestal, no soil island. Neutral soft light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow only toward lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background and generous blank alpha0 margins all four sides; no skyline, no surrounding scenery. No people, writing, Chinese pseudo-glyphs, text, plaques, signs, banners, watermark, grid, modern fittings, plastic render, cartoon, ink wash, oversaturation, dense lanterns, white halo or baked checkerboard. Only building and its own footprint; include all eaves and base corners uncropped. Asset ID bld_kit_ming_north_biaoju. Footprint 15 metres east-west by 12 metres north-south. A practical escort freight yard, high grey-brick walls and hard-gabled grey clay roofs, secure timber double gate, rear hall and side freight sheds, a few tied burlap cargo bales and plain crates entirely within yard. Unmarked poles, no named escort sign or flags, no weapons display. Secular robust north-China compound, anonymous gameplay extension. Correction: ALL ROOFS are NORTHERN CHINESE YINGSHAN hard-gabled with tall flush masonry triangular ends, NO overhanging eaves at gable ends and absolutely NO upward-curled corner tips. Main hall is a practical low secure freight office, not a Song palace. Keep clear cargo bales and crates. Ground rectangle axes +0.5/-0.5 exactly, width15 depth12.
